facts.title: Trent shares decline 2.5% ahead of Q1 FY27 earnings
facts.takeaway: Trent's Q1 FY27 standalone revenue was Rs 5,666 crore, up 18.5% year on year, with 1,312 stores as of June 30, 2026.

facts.title: Trent share price today: why the stock may see some correction post Q1 update
